description.value: Breka Bakery & Café is a Vancouver family-owned institution founded in 2006, now operating eight locations across the city around the clock every day of the year. The West 4th Avenue café offers an extensive selection of baked goods, sandwiches, soups, and beverages — including dedicated vegan and gluten-friendly items — with online ordering and a Grab & Go section. Its 24/7 availability makes it a rare option for cyclists riding early mornings, late nights, or any hour in between.

bike_parking_detail: 9 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 10m; rack (7 spaces) at 16m; rack (8 spaces, covered) at 43m; rack (5 spaces) at 50m; rack (4 spaces) at 84m; rack (5 spaces, covered) at 86m; rack (4 spaces, covered) at 87m; rack (4 spaces) at 89m; rack (4 spaces) at 94m. Total: 43 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business name, 24/7 operation, and West 4th Avenue location as one of 8 branches. Vegan and gluten-free items are explicitly labeled in the online menu, corroborating OSM diet tags. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all bike-infrastructure and utility amenities remain null.
concerns: Required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are all unconfirmed — website contains no information about any of these.
Website lists West 4th Avenue as one of 8 locations but does not provide per-location street numbers or individual amenity details, making address corroboration partial.
Phone number from OSM (+1-604-620-3750) does not appear in the fetched website content and could not be independently confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Breka is a well-established, always-open food stop that would be genuinely useful to touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify before listing.
